evidence_category: Lean kernel-compiled generic mathematical implications about actual convergent real power series and local equality/invariance.
exact_results: For normed real vector spaces E,F, actual HasFPowerSeriesAt f p x and HasFPowerSeriesAt g q x plus local equality f=g imply equality p_n(y,...,y)=q_n(y,...,y) for every natural n and every y.
If HasFPowerSeriesAt f p 0 and L is a continuous real linear map E to E with f composed with L locally equal to f at zero, then p_n(Ly,...,Ly)=p_n(y,...,y) for every n,y.
If the same actual f is locally even at zero, every odd diagonal coefficient p_n(y,...,y) is zero.
proof_outline: Transport the first actual series along local function equality. Subtract the second actual convergent series to obtain a series representing zero. Apply pinned HasFPowerSeriesAt.apply_eq_zero, which already proves diagonal uniqueness over arbitrary normed spaces.
Compose the actual convergent series with L using HasFPowerSeriesAt.compContinuousLinearMap. L sends zero to zero. Apply diagonal uniqueness to this composed series and the original series.

For local evenness take L=-id. Multilinearity gives p_n(-y,...,-y)=(-1)^n times p_n(y,...,y). Odd n makes the factor -1; equality with the original diagonal implies 2 times that vector is zero, hence it vanishes over the real scalar field.
adaptation_from_requested_route: The requested one-dimensional restriction route was unnecessary because pinned Mathlib.Analysis.Analytic.Uniqueness.apply_eq_zero directly supplies the required diagonal uniqueness. This uses the same permitted standard foundation and makes no stronger off-diagonal uniqueness claim.
hypothesis_audit: E and F are arbitrary normed real vector spaces; no finite-dimensionality or completeness assumption is present.
L need not be invertible, an isometry, nonzero, or globally symmetry-preserving; actual local function invariance is explicit.
No symmetry assumption is imposed on the continuous multilinear coefficient maps, and no equality or vanishing of their arbitrary off-diagonal values is asserted.
HasFPowerSeriesAt is the actual pinned convergent-series predicate. The theorem does not identify a particular physical series or construct its coefficients.
The diagonal equality includes n=0; the vanishing corollary explicitly requires Odd n.
